# Learn skill purpose

The `learn` skill converts repeated, independently evidenced migration outcomes into **candidate** reusable patterns and atomic skill-change proposals. It exists so later migrations can benefit from accepted experience without relying on chat history or silently modifying active procedures.

The skill is deliberately narrower than an autonomous skill-evolution agent. It cannot approve promotion, change business intent, relax evidence, browse learning memory during ordinary migration stages, or generalize a local result across models and runtimes. Its outputs are governed by `docs/learning/WIKI_CONTRACT.md`; repository paths, hashes, Git commits, one-skill diffs, patches, frozen evaluators, and result files are verified; a different checker reruns the evidence; and promotion requires a durable human gate bound to the reviewed candidate commit.
